notes: Step 1 of the repo's script: count commas per raw physical line of the corrupted CSV via COUNTC(_infile_,','), then PROC FREQ the distribution. Original 'infile d:/csv/2536_bridge_conditions.csv' + bare 'input;' replaced with inline DATALINES sampled verbatim from the repo's own 2536_bridge_conditions.csv (header rows + a normal data row + the 3-line wrapped address field that causes the corruption). The bare 'INPUT;' + _INFILE_ idiom the original uses does not currently parse on Jenner (filed as a regression test); worked around here with a named $char500. variable capturing the same raw line and running the identical COUNTC() logic, so the bundle still demonstrates the repo's actual diagnostic: wrapped multi-line fields collapse to low comma counts (0, 1, 34) versus well-formed ~35/36.
